overview: City Councillors Anna Callahan and Justin Tseng hosted a Ward 5 listening session to hear resident feedback on municipal issues. Discussions focused on traffic calming, street safety, noise regulations, snow removal, tree canopy initiatives, and air traffic concerns.

items.title: Ward 5 Listening Session Opening Remarks
items.summary: Councillors Anna Callahan and Justin Tseng opened the Ward 5 listening session to gather neighborhood feedback and review meeting logistics.

items.title: Public Comment on Neighborhood Concerns
items.summary: Ward 5 residents and Zoom participants raised issues including traffic safety, zoning, tree canopy loss, snow removal, housing affordability, and pedestrian access.

items.title: Traffic Calming and Street Safety
items.summary: Participants and councillors discussed traffic calming solutions, speed enforcement, infrastructure improvements, and police department staffing levels.

items.title: Noise Ordinance and Cut-Through Heavy Trucking
items.summary: Councillors reviewed proposed updates to the city's noise ordinance and explained plans to address heavy truck cut-through traffic in upcoming committee meetings.

items.title: Local ICE Policies, Tree Canopy, and Vacant Buildings
items.summary: Councillors outlined local regulations regarding ICE enforcement, announced a spring volunteer tree-planting program, and detailed a proposed vacant building ordinance.

items.title: Tufts Park Upkeep and Winter Snow Removal
items.summary: Councillors addressed resident concerns regarding maintenance at Tufts Park and discussed city efforts to improve winter snow plowing operations and DPW equipment.

items.title: Massport Air Traffic Noise Update
items.summary: Massport Community Advisory Committee representative Micah Kesselman provided an update on efforts to study and alter flight patterns causing local air traffic noise.
